source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that approved NVMe Configuration values persist across save/reboot and return to SPEC defaults after Load Default without losing controller, namespace, boot or storage availability.
original_method: Change NVMe fields in BIOS, save/reboot and verify persistence; then Load Default, save/reboot and compare with SPEC while collecting firmware, controller/namespace, boot, storage-health and log evidence.
manual_activity: A human must navigate the firmware NVMe page, perform both save/reboot/default phases and inspect the values. Automated read-only NVMe inventory cannot replace those core actions.
required_inputs: Named NVMe fields with baseline, safe non-default and SPEC-default values
Boot, mount, encryption, RAID and data dependencies
Console/operator, backups, stable power, recovery media and BMC/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or guess disk/namespace identity.
Do not format, write, sanitize, repartition or alter namespaces/RAID/encryption as an implicit check.
Protect OS, mounted, in-use and otherwise protected disks from unauthorized writes.
Stop on missing controller/namespace, boot/storage degradation, media errors or management loss.
Restore the approved final firmware storage state.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only NVMe controller/namespace/serial/health, PCI, mount, boot, OS and BMC evidence.
Compare operator BIOS captures and exact device identities against the approved matrix.
Do not drive BIOS, perform storage writes/resets, infer interchangeable disks or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Define/approve NVMe fields/defaults, protected-device map, recovery and final state.
Evaluate firmware and read-only storage evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; NVMe/PCI/OS tools are read-only supporting checks and must never become write or namespace-management probes.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the manual BIOS sequence and use platform-approved read-only identity, namespace, health, mount and boot inventory; do not substitute OS controller settings or destructive NVMe commands.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source two-phase sequence, no-script state and 5/20-minute fields are preserved; all/random remains source wording but is bounded for safe execution.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each approved BIOS field to exact controller, namespace, serial, slot, boot/data role and expected visibility; capture firmware plus read-only storage identity/health at baseline, persistence, default restoration and final state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS/storage topology and installed NVMe devices.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, controller/drive firmware, OS/kernel and inventory-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform NVMe Configuration specification and project storage topology/recovery definition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable device identity and non-destructive storage boundaries while retaining the two firmware transitions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; it does not claim namespace, RAID, encryption or performance coverage unless separately approved.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field/default matrix, device-role map and recovery plan.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Device names may reorder after reboot; serial/slot/controller identity must be used instead of volatile OS names.

project_override_considerations: The project may select safe NVMe fields and named controllers. Completion applies only to that matrix and must not claim write-path, destructive namespace or all-device coverage.
expected_evidence: Identity, approval, exact storage/boot/dependency baseline and recovery readiness
First save/reboot persistence plus read-only controller/namespace/health evidence
Load Default, second save/reboot, SPEC comparison and storage/boot health
Final storage configuration, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require persistence and SPEC-default restoration. Missing fields and device dependencies are readiness inputs, not conflicting facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The firmware lifecycle is clear. Exact device identity, values and recovery gate execution but do not permanently block the common library case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with manual BIOS classification and adds storage-identity and no-write controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its useful read-only NVMe evidence and recovery analysis but rejects PARTIAL based solely on supporting automation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Restores MANUAL ONLY under the locked core-acceptance rule and makes protected storage boundaries explicit.

review_improvement: Prevents volatile device names or automated evidence collection from authorizing writes to boot, mounted or encrypted storage and preserves exact-device traceability.
independent_technical_reasoning: Human firmware interaction and visual persistence/default checks are decisive, so MANUAL ONLY applies. Read-only NVMe evidence is support and cannot automate the core acceptance.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat firmware changes, reboot or default load after missing media, namespace/boot changes or ambiguous evidence; preserve the first state and obtain engineer disposition.
